prose: Beartaria Legend Pat Daly of the P.A.T. Life podcast makes his Vibe Rant debut to talk about his work helping clients develop present awareness through exercise and mental tactics. On deck to riff with us tonight is Dylan Saccoccio, author of Get Mad or Get Realistic and the Spirit Whirled series.
dropped: in the block (Spirit Whirled audiobook narrated by Chance)
